title: PX4 SITL GPS denial: inject, measure drift, recover
summary: Flies a square mission in PX4 SITL (SIH quadrotor, headless; Gazebo also works per PX4 docs), denies GPS mid-mission, logs EKF2 health and estimated vs ground-truth position, then restores GPS and returns home. GPS denial tries MAVSDK failure injection and falls back to SIM_GPS_USED=0 because PX4 v1.17 SIH does not acknowledge GPS failure injection. A stdlib analyzer reports per-phase horizontal drift and time to a 5 m error.
verified: Ran on 2026-11-06 against PX4 v1.17.0 SIH (sihsim_quadx) in Docker from samples/sitl-docker (linux/arm64) with mavsdk-grpc 4.0.5 (its bundled mavsdk_server runs on linux aarch64; the macOS arm64 wheel binary starts but was not flown). Two flights of the same 15 s GPS denial (fresh containers each): run A 8.37 m max horizontal error and 12.7 s to 5 m, run B 17.71 m and 8.5 s (drift.py on the MAVSDK logs, output in README). ulog_drift.py (pyulog 1.3.0) ran on the run B .ulg: 18.30 m max during denial, 7.8 s to 5 m, agreeing with the MAVSDK log at ~125 Hz. MAV_CMD_INJECT_FAILURE for GPS timed out (no ACK) on this target. drift.py tests (4) pass. Not run: gz_x500 (Gazebo).
first_command: docker exec px4client sh -c 'cd /sample && python gps_denial_mission.py --deny-via sim-param --log /tmp/flight_log.csv'
shows: 15 s GPS denial on PX4 v1.17.0 SIH, EKF2 drift vs ground truth
key_result: [Two runs](README.md#observed): max horizontal error 8.37 m and 17.71 m, 12.7 s and 8.5 s to 5 m; [ULog truth](README.md#truth-from-the-ulog-instead-ulog_driftpy-ran-on-run-b) for run B 18.30 m
